Graeme Hinton was always the obvious internal candidate to replace Peter V’landys at Racing NSW. However, the process was unusually swift: one full business day between V’landys confirming his departure and Hinton’s appointment, no external search, and Brad Hazzard’s review of Racing NSW’s governance still unreleased.

Top-priced yearlings and stellar pinhook results have given Nick Fairweather and Nicole Brown's Carlaw Park the confidence to take things to a new level. The respected spelling and yearling consignment operation will celebrate a decade of progress when moving into the historic Parkvale Farm next month.

The December International meeting beckons for Invincible Ibis after he resumed with a victory in the G3 Celebration Cup. Per Incanto sired a double at Sha Tin, while apprentice jockey Nichola Yuen had her first treble in the region.

Resolute Racing's globetrotter Goliath returned to Germany on Sunday to win the G1 Cologne's G1 Mehl-Mulhens-Stiftung Preis von Europa. In Japan, Puca Magic won the Sprinters Stakes at Nakayama with a couple of Aussie mares providing winners on the day.

Trainer Ciaron Maher won four of the first five races on the card at Caulfield on Sunday before taking out the headline act with a rejuvenated Jimmysstar in the G1 Manikato Stakes to make it five. Pride Of Jenni won her third successive G2 Feehan Stakes.

With a pedigree to die for, Saturday’s G3 Heritage Stakes winner Blue Door is hunting for a slot in the G1 The Everest. The expensive yearling from one of Australia’s best families has thrown strongly to her speedy, precocious sire line.

With several stable stars headed towards Group 1 targets in the next few weeks, the spring looks exciting Grahame Begg’s yard. She’s A Hustler is headed to the Caulfield Cup and Zakouma has already won a ballot free entry to the Melbourne Cup.

For the second successive time, the gross was over US$500 million for the 12-day Keeneland September Yearling Sale. The average was the sixth time in a row they’ve broken the record average, and the number of seven figure yearlings hit 70 up from 56 in 2025. Gun Runner was the leading sire across the whole sale.
